levels.level1TrialDesignAndEfficacy: Two phase 3 randomized trials INSPIRE-1 and INSPIRE-2 met ACR20 primary endpoint at 24 weeks with p<0.05 versus placebo; prior July 21 2025 topline report.
levels.level2ClinicalBenefitAndSafety: Meaningful joint symptom reduction for active psoriatic arthritis. Established tildrakizumab profile in plaque psoriasis; company reported no new signals in phase 3 studies. Public data lacks final clinical dossier.
levels.level3RegulatoryFit: Sponsor announced FDA acceptance March 16 2026 with Oct 29 target; existing approved biologic plus two positive pivotal studies favors supplemental label expansion, but inspection/CMC and FDA complete review unknown.
